verdict.rationale: Docs show privacy-preserving defaults (local-only scanning, --dry-run to avoid upload, no login required), giving users some control over whether data leaves their machine, but there is no evidence of explicit data retention periods, deletion mechanisms, or account/data-erasure controls for data that is uploaded to the Semgrep AppSec Platform. missing for 10: documented retention policy, explicit deletion/erasure controls for platform-stored findings, GDPR/CCPA data handling commitments.
